‼️Barring any last minute setbacks, Joao Cancelo will sign a 2-year contract with Barcelona until June 2028.

The club's sporting department believes that Cancelo's experience, versatility and familiarity with the dressing room is a strategic addition to Hansi Flick's team and the coach hopes to have the player available as soon as possible ahead of the new season.
#FCB 🇵🇹

Via (🟡): @JoanPoquiEraso [md]

🔄 (CANCELO): The countdown to Joao Cancelo's return to Barcelona has begun. Negotiations between all parties is progressing well and optimism is growing with hopes of finalizing it in the next days.

Barcelona anticipate that the deal will be closed between €8-10m. Although some details are yet to be polished, the player's desire to return to Barça has been key in bringing the stances of the two club's close.
#FCB 🇵🇹

Via (🟡): @JoanPoquiEraso [md]

🔄 (RODRI): Barcelona are closely monitoring Rodri's situation and could make a move if the right conditions arise. Frenkie de Jong's injury has reignited the club's debate on needing a midfielder.

Barça will attempt to sign Rodri if the player clearly expresses his desire to join the club. They can afford a transfer fee of around €50m.

Barça know that Rodri likes their project although they are also aware that Real Madrid are currently leading the race for the midfielder.
#FCB 🇪🇸

❗️Jofre Torrents is described as an ‘interesting’ player within Ajax. He is someone followed closely by them.

However there is still no scene of an agreement prevalent. If it comes to fruition, it’ll probably be a loan deal with an option to buy.

Via (🟢): @MikeVerweij [telegraaf]

❗️ Barça will loan Jofre Torrents to Ajax with a purchase option, but it will not be a mandatory one.

Ajax would have the option to buy 50% of his rights for around €5M. 

Barça would include a buy-back clause that could be worth around €15M.

🗣️ @ffpolo : “If you choose to think positively, even on X you can actually be optimistic about the Barcelona team that is coming.

Because Lamine Yamal, Raphinha and Andreas Christensen should enjoy much better seasons after the injuries that disrupted their previous campaign.

Because the newly crowned World Cup champions will return full of confidence after lifting the trophy.

Because Gavi and Marc Bernal should begin the season free from the knee problems that held them back.

Because Alejandro Balde and Jules Koundé are entering a crucial season and are expected to respond.

Because Fermín López will be extra motivated after missing out on the World Cup, and Ronald Araújo has overcome his mental health struggles.

Because Anthony Gordon, Karim Adeyemi and Hamza will all be eager to make their mark.

Because Frenkie de Jong will once again be in the spotlight.

Because Hansi Flick has finally got the fitness coach he wanted.

And because La Masia continues to produce outstanding talent, while Barcelona are coming off back-to-back La Liga titles.

Have faith.”

The same people demanding the signing today would be the first to call for Deco’s head tomorrow.”
